key_insight: TokenCast forecasts an LLM agent’s total token cost during execution by modeling each step as a composable cost segment that includes both its own usage and the context growth it causes.
engineering_relevance: This enables more reliable budget control for agentic systems, letting developers revise token forecasts online without extra LLM calls and better manage cost-sensitive deployments.
method: Learns a composable representation for each execution segment.
Accumulates segment costs to estimate downstream re-read overhead from growing context.
Updates forecasts as new evidence appears, with no additional LLM inference calls.
evidence_signal: Evaluated across 4 task suites and 6 agent models, TokenCast reduced mean absolute error by 14.5% on average over 96 combinations and cut tokens by 21.3% in offline budget-control replay versus a fixed-budget policy.
watch_item: Forecast quality may depend on how representative the observed execution traces are, so performance could degrade on unfamiliar tools, tasks, or agent behaviors.
paper_title: TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution
